verses.t: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense
verses.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion
verses.yusufAli: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)
verses.rodwell: WHAT thinkest thou of him who treateth our RELIGION as a lie
verses.sale: What thinkest thou of him who denieth the future judgment as a falsehood

verses.t: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
verses.pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan
verses.yusufAli: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness)
verses.rodwell: He it is who trusteth away the orphan
verses.sale: It is he who pusheth away the orphan

verses.t: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor
verses.pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy
verses.yusufAli: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent
verses.rodwell: And stirreth not others up to feed the poor
verses.sale: and stirreth not up others to feed the poor

verses.t: So woe to those who pray
verses.sale: Woe be unto those who pray

verses.t: [But] who are heedless of their prayer
verses.pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer
verses.yusufAli: Who are neglectful of their prayers
verses.rodwell: But in their prayer are careless
verses.sale: and who are negligent at their prayer

verses.t: Those who make show [of their deeds]
verses.yusufAli: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men)
verses.rodwell: Who make a shew of devotion
But refuse help to the needy
verses.sale: and deny necessaries to the needy
